faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.meta-description: Answers to the most common questions about Farada products and services
faq.how-to-order: How can I order products from Farada?
faq.how-to-order-answer: You can order products through our website or mobile app. Select the desired products, add them to your cart, then complete the payment process. You can also order by phone at +966-55-766-5585.
faq.payment-methods-answer: We offer several payment methods: credit cards and Mada, cash on delivery, bank transfer, and payment through digital wallets like STC Pay and Apple Pay.
faq.modify-cancel-order: Can I modify or cancel my order?
faq.modify-cancel-order-answer: Yes, you can modify or cancel your order before shipping begins. Contact us immediately by phone or email. After shipping starts, cancellation is subject to our return and exchange policy.
faq.delivery-time-answer: Delivery time varies by region: Riyadh (1-2 business days), major cities (2-3 business days), remote areas (3-5 business days). We also offer express shipping for nearby areas.
faq.free-shipping-answer: Shipping is free for Riyadh, 25 SAR for major cities, and 35 SAR for remote areas. Orders over 200 SAR get free shipping to all areas.
faq.track-order: How can I track my order?
faq.track-order-answer: You will receive a tracking number via email and SMS. You can use this number to track your order status through our website or mobile app.
faq.return-policy-answer: You can return the product within 14 days of receipt if it's defective or doesn't match specifications. We offer multiple options: money refund, product replacement, or store credit.
faq.return-processing-time: How long does return processing take?
faq.return-processing-time-answer: Return processing takes 5-9 business days: product receipt (1-2 days), product inspection (1-2 days), order processing (3-5 days).
faq.create-account: How can I create an account?
faq.create-account-answer: You can easily create an account through our website or mobile app. Enter your email and phone number, then follow the instructions to complete registration.
faq.data-security-answer: Yes, we use advanced encryption technologies to protect your personal information and payment data. We adhere to strict privacy policies and do not share your information with third parties.
faq.working-hours-answer: Working hours: Sunday - Thursday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Saturday from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM, Friday closed.
faq.contact-customer-service: How can I contact customer service?
faq.contact-customer-service-answer: You can contact us by phone: +966-55-766-5585, email: info@farada.com, or through the contact form on our website.
faq.no-answer-found: Didn't find an answer to your question?
faq.customer-service-available: Our customer service team is available to help you with any other inquiries
